versions.content: If FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength exists and is set to TRUE for the associated frame triggering, the actual L-SDU length, that is passed to the driver by calling Fr_TransmitTxLPdu(), shall be determined (i.e. shortened as much as possible) by taking only those PDUs into account, which have been indicated via <UL_Trigger Transmit>() and consider the following points: • the position of the respective PDU within the L-SDU • the actual length of the respective PDU as passed via <UL_TriggerTransmit>()
